expect_stderr_contains: BLOCKED (git discipline): blanket staging via git add -A / --all / .
_why: Old git-discipline-guard.ps1's prefix regex used bare \S+ for -C's value, which cannot span the space inside a quoted 'C:/my repo' -- the prefix match breaks mid-string and the rule never fires, so the old side ALLOWS this blanket `add -A`. The unified global_option_prefix (lib/gitcmd.py) adds quoted-argument support, so the new side correctly parses the -C value and BLOCKS. Tightening only (CONTRACT PE-4).
